fullPassage: Imagine following the spirit of a silence vow into daily life. Challenge yourself to spend an entire day saying only what you absolutely must say. It's been widely observed by behavioral psychology experts — and anyone who's ever been on a first date — that we too often tend to treat "conversation" as a game of waiting for our own turn to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. What if you could eliminate the idea that the next available mini-silence is your next opening to express whatever is in your head? What if you were limited to, say, fifty spoken words tomorrow? I think you'd listen quite differently. You'd attend quite carefully to every word you heard. You'd be attuned to what you must respond to. You might discover that the less you say, the more you hear.

It's been widely observed by behavioral psychology experts — and anyone who's ever been on a first date — that we too often tend to __________ to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. What if you could eliminate the idea that the next available mini-silence is your next opening to express whatever is in your head? What if you were limited to, say, fifty spoken words tomorrow? I think you'd listen quite differently. You'd attend quite carefully to every word you heard. You'd be attuned to what you must respond to. You might discover that the less you say, the more you hear.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 주제 — 침묵과 경청을 통한 소통의 질 향상
det.analysis:
① 대화 기술 훈련 — 기술 향상이 아닌 침묵과 경청이 핵심
② 행동심리학 영향 — 예시일 뿐 주제 아님
③ 말을 줄이고 경청 — silence vow + the less you say, the more you hear ←정답
④ 정신 건강 효과 — 의학적 효과 언급 없음
det.tip: 핵심: silence → listen → hear more

ch: 효과적인 대화 기술을 향상시키는 훈련 방법

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글의 요지 — 말을 줄이면 경청의 질이 높아진다는 주장
det.analysis:
① 의견 표현 중요 — 글은 반대(말을 줄이라고 함)
② 첫 데이트 경청 — 예시일 뿐 요지 아님
③ 전문가 조언 따르기 — 전문가는 현상 설명 역할
④ 말을 줄이면 경청 — the less you say, the more you hear ←정답
det.tip: 요지 = 말을 의식적으로 제한하면 듣기 질이 높아짐

ch: 대화에서는 자신의 의견을 적극적으로 표현하는 것이 중요하다.
첫 데이트에서는 상대방의 말에 경청하는 태도가 필수적이다.
심리학 전문가들의 조언을 따르면 의사소통 능력이 향상된다.
말하는 양을 의식적으로 줄이면 상대의 말을 더 깊이 들을 수 있다.
